cards.ex: I told her I liked her dress, but it was a white lie.
cards.exUz: Men unga ko'ylagini yoqtirishimni aytdim, lekin bu oq yolg'on edi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, zarar keltirmaydigan yolg'on, odatda kimnidir xafa qilmaslik uchun aytiladi.

cards.ex: He tends to stretch the truth when he's telling stories about his adventures.
cards.exUz: U sarguzashtlari haqida hikoya qilganda, rostni bo'rttirishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani biroz o'zgartirib, uni kattaroq yoki muhimroq ko'rsatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I'm sorry, it was an honest mistake. I didn't mean to delete your file.
cards.exUz: Kechirasiz, bu halol xato edi. Men sizning faylingizni o'chirishni xohlamadim.
cards.uzDef: Qasddan qilinmagan, vijdonan adashish.

cards.ex: You should just come clean and tell them what really happened.
cards.exUz: Siz shunchaki tan olib, aslida nima bo'lganini ularga aytishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yashirgan narsasini oshkor qilmoq, ayniqsa noto'g'ri ish qilgan bo'lsa.

cards.ex: I expect full disclosure; I want to know everything about this deal.
cards.exUz: Men to'liq oshkor bo'lishini kutaman; Men bu kelishuv haqida hamma narsani bilishni xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: Barcha ma'lumotlarni, hech narsani yashirmasdan oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: He lied through his teeth when he said he hadn't seen her.
cards.exUz: U uni ko'rmaganini aytganda, ko'zini chimirib yolg'on gapirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqchasiga yolg'on gapirish, hech qanday uyat his qilmasdan.

cards.ex: I tend to take people at face value until they give me a reason not to.
cards.exUz: Odamlar menga ishonmaslik uchun sabab berguncha, ularni so'ziga ishonishga moyilman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning haqiqiyligini tekshirmasdan, shundayligicha qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Politicians often bend the truth to make themselves look better.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilar ko'pincha o'zlarini yaxshiroq ko'rsatish uchun rostni buzadilar.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni biroz o'zgartirib, uni qulayroq qilish.

cards.ex: We want to make sure everything is above board and completely transparent.
cards.exUz: Biz hamma narsa halol va butunlay shaffof bo'lishini ta'minlamoqchimiz.
cards.uzDef: Halol va ochiq, hech qanday yashirin narsa yo'q.

cards.ex: He cooked up a story about being stuck in traffic to explain why he was late.
cards.exUz: U kechikkanini tushuntirish uchun tirbandlikda qolib ketganligi haqida hikoya to'qidi.
cards.uzDef: Yolg'on hikoyani o'ylab topish.

cards.ex: We need to get to the bottom of this mystery and find out what really happened.
cards.exUz: Biz bu sirning tubiga yetishimiz va aslida nima bo'lganini aniqlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror muammoning asl sababini topish.

cards.ex: In all honesty, I didn't really enjoy the movie.
cards.exUz: Rostini aytsam, men filmdan unchalik zavqlanmadim.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy fikringizni aytayotganingizni ta'kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: I expect everyone to play fair during the competition.
cards.exUz: Musobaqa davomida hamma halol o'ynashini kutaman.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga rioya qilgan holda, adolatli bo'lish.

cards.ex: I had to call him out on his lies; I couldn't let him get away with it.
cards.exUz: Men uni yolg'onlari uchun fosh qilishim kerak edi; Men unga buni o'tkazib yubora olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir yolg'on yoki noto'g'ri harakatini oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: She's a very trustworthy person; you can always count on her.
cards.exUz: U juda ishonchli odam; siz har doim unga ishonishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ishonishga arziydigan, rostgo'y.

cards.ex: You should take everything he says with a grain of salt; he tends to exaggerate.
cards.exUz: Siz uning har bir gapiga shubha bilan qarashingiz kerak; u bo'rttirishga moyil.
cards.term: take with a grain of salt
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga to'liq ishonmasdan, shubha bilan qarash.

cards.ex: I'm telling you the honest to goodness truth.
cards.exUz: Men sizga haqiqiy rostni aytyapman.
cards.uzDef: Chinakam, haqiqiy, hech qanday yolg'on yo'q.

cards.ex: It's important to keep your word and follow through on your commitments.
cards.exUz: Va'daga sodiq bo'lish va majburiyatlarni bajarish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Va'da bergan narsani bajarish.

cards.ex: His entire story was a pack of lies.
cards.exUz: Uning butun hikoyasi yolg'on uyumi edi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p yolg'onlarning to'plami.

cards.ex: I can see through your lies; I know you're not telling the truth.
cards.exUz: Men sizning yolg'onlaringizni ko'ryapman; Men bilaman, siz rost gapirmayapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir haqiqiy niyatlarini payqab qolish.

cards.ex: You need to be up front with your boss about the problem.
cards.exUz: Siz rahbaringiz bilan muammo haqida ochiq bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq va halol bo'lish, hech narsani yashirmaslik.

cards.ex: I would never grass on my friends, even if they did something wrong.
cards.exUz: Men hech qachon do'stlarimni sotmayman, hatto ular noto'g'ri ish qilgan bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir noto'g'ri ish qilganini boshqalarga aytish (ko'pincha politsiyaga).

cards.ex: The company tried to bury the truth about the accident.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya baxtsiz hodisa haqidagi haqiqatni yashirishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni yashirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Let's call a spade a spade - this project is a disaster.
cards.exUz: Keling, ochig'ini aytaylik - bu loyiha falokat.
cards.uzDef: Nimani bo'lsa shuni aytish, hech qanday yashirin narsa yo'q.

cards.ex: He deliberately misled me about the price of the car.
cards.exUz: U mashinaning narxi haqida meni ataylab adashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir noto'g'ri yo'lga solish, yolg'on ma'lumot berish.

cards.ex: He told me a half-truth, leaving out the most important details.
cards.exUz: U menga yarim rostni aytdi, eng muhim detallarni qoldirib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: To'liq bo'lmagan haqiqat, aslida yolg'on.

cards.ex: If you play it straight with me, I'll do the same for you.
cards.exUz: Agar men bilan halol bo'lsangiz, men ham siz uchun shunday qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Halol va rostgo'y bo'lish, hech qanday hiyla ishlatmaslik.

cards.ex: They are trying to hide the truth from the public.
cards.exUz: Ular rostni jamoatchilikdan yashirishga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni oshkor qilmaslikka harakat qilish.

cards.ex: You can trust him; he's always on the level.
cards.exUz: Siz unga ishonishingiz mumkin; u har doim rostgo'y.
cards.uzDef: Halol va rostgo'y, firib yo'q.

cards.ex: I'm determined to find out the truth, no matter what it takes.
cards.exUz: Men rostni bilishga qaror qildim, nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni aniqlash, bilib olish.
